rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for a cupboard or storage cabinet.

example.english: There are lots of books in that cupboard.
example.jyutping: go2 go3 gwai6 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 syu1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a kitchen cupboard or cabinet for cookware, dishes, or food.

example.english: I put the bowls back in the cupboard.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 di1 wun2 fong3 faan1 jap6 cyu4 gwai6
